# RCTab test data

These fixtures are copied unchanged from the test data of [RCTab](https://github.com/BrightSpots/rcv) v2.1.0,
`src/test/resources/network/brightspots/rcv/test_data/`, Copyright (c) 2017-2023 Bright Spots Developers.

They're covered by the Mozilla Public License, v. 2.0, as stated in that directory's `LICENSE.html`, not by this repo's
licenses. You can obtain a copy of the MPL at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.

`alaska_partial/` is `2024_alaska_dominion/partial_cvr/`, and each `test_set_*` directory holds that test's config, CVR and
expected report, renamed to `config.json`, `cvr.json` and `expected_detailed_report.json`.
